The dense, unbroken format of Response b, together with its off‑topic digressions, creates a more confusing logical order. Consequently, Response a demonstrates a higher level of logical coherence.

consistency_internal.explantion: Both responses suffer from similar categories of flaws—use of promotional eNotes excerpts, attribution failures, and false‑consensus statements. Therefore, Response a maintains a higher degree of internal consistency compared with Response b.
